title: The most serious story on my desk this morning is a pair of vulnerabilities in the Barracuda Email Security Gateway, specifically CVE-2026-1
content_md:
The most serious story on my desk this morning is a pair of vulnerabilities in the Barracuda Email Security Gateway, specifically CVE-2026-1

via Mastodon https://theperimetersite.com/report/447

CVE-2026-111560.evidence: The Perimeter Site reports an unauthenticated Barracuda ESG exploit chain to root via CVE-2026-111560.

CVE-2026-116606.evidence: The Perimeter Site reports an unauthenticated Barracuda ESG exploit chain to root via CVE-2026-116606.
